_comment: Resource type to the child settings that carry decisions. A resource listing does not return these.
Keys are lower-case. path is relative to the resource id. type is the child's provider type, used to resolve its api-version.
An empty list means the type was reviewed and has nothing to read. A live type with no entry at all is reported as unmapped.
postOnly names settings that can only be read with a POST. They are recorded as NotObserved and never read.
allResources lists reads made on every resource that is not platform-managed. subscription lists reads made once per subscription.

select keeps only the named fields of each item, under the last path segment. drop removes the named properties at any depth: a budget's spend figures and contact addresses are not this audit's to hold.

apiVersion pins the version for one read. The provider metadata is the default, but it can mislead: diagnostic settings are listed with no default and one old stable version that answers this read with 404 (observed 2026-11-13).

absentWhen lists error texts that mean the child does not exist (observed 2026-11-13: a Container App with no platform auth answers 404 AuthConfigNotFound; a PostgreSQL server with Entra sign-in off answers 400). Only a listed text is read as absent; any other failure stays NotObserved, so a wrong path here cannot pass for an absence.
